# Append this month's entry to the Venmo Expenses SimpleNote note
from datetime import datetime
import calendar

# Login simple_note
pw = {a['account_name']: a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
access_token_simple = apis.simple_note.login(username='chris.mcco@gmail.com', password=pw['simple_note'])['access_token']

note_id = 3084

# Derive this month's key
now_dt = datetime.now()
month_key = f"{now_dt.month:02d}/{str(now_dt.year)[-2:]}"  # MM/YY

# Compute this month's total sent on Venmo
venmo_token = apis.venmo.login(username='chris.mcco@gmail.com', password=pw['venmo'])['access_token']
first_day = f"{now_dt.year:04d}-{now_dt.month:02d}-01"
last_day = f"{now_dt.year:04d}-{now_dt.month:02d}-{calendar.monthrange(now_dt.year, now_dt.month)[1]:02d}"

transactions = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=venmo_token,
        direction='sent',
        min_created_at=first_day,
        max_created_at=last_day,
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=20
    )
    if not page:
        break
    transactions.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
    if page_index > 100:
        break

monthly_total = sum([float(t.get('amount', 0)) for t in transactions if t.get('amount') is not None])
entry_line = f"- {month_key} => ${monthly_total:.1f}"

# Fetch current note to ensure not already present
note = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=access_token_simple, note_id=note_id)
if month_key in note['content']:
    print('Entry already present; no update performed.')
    print('month_key:', month_key)
    print('note_id:', note_id)
else:
    resp = apis.simple_note.add_content_to_note(
        access_token=access_token_simple,
        note_id=note_id,
        append_or_prepend='append',
        added_content=entry_line
    )
    print('Update response:', resp)
    print('Appended:', entry_line)

# Verify updated content includes entry
updated = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=access_token_simple, note_id=note_id)
print('Contains entry?', entry_line in updated['content'])
print('Updated content tail:')
print('\n'.join(updated['content'].splitlines()[-6:]))
